managedRoute.checking: Checking the recommended release and destination…
managedRoute.description: Portcove prepares a separate copy and switches to it only after verification. Your current registration stays usable until then, and its external files stay where they are.
managedRoute.differentHandling: This proposed change has different file or data handling. Keep your current copy and update Portcove before reviewing it again.
managedRoute.failure: The route change was not confirmed. Review the current installation before trying again.
managedRoute.optionsNote: These choices are saved for future managed installs. They do not move or change your external files.
managedRoute.preserves: Portcove updates the new installation and preserves the saves and settings covered by its recorded rules. Your external saves are not copied. A game that uses an upstream profile may still read the same profile when you choose Play; keep a separate backup of that data.
managedRoute.previousFiles: Your previous files remain at <path/>. You can keep using them separately. The saved update policy stays in effect; Play remains a separate action.
managedRoute.title: Use a managed copy of <name/>?
